## Descripción original

Pika H3 Flex Built for professional iteration. Six-step generation · Omni-reference · Native 480p / 768p · Up to 4K via Pika API

Model weights · Watch samples · Quickstart · Prompt guide · Pika API extensions

Pika H3 Flex is a post-trained H3 model, designed to give professional creators the flexibility and speed to explore with precision. Optimized for greater control, it generates video with synchronized audio in six sampling steps and supports up to 12 reference inputs, with shot direction through references and prompts.

Pika’s hosted API extends this workflow with 1080p, 2K and 4K video generation, audio stems and prompt enhancement. Local open-weight inference supports native 480p / 768p video with mixed stereo audio.
